data.gender_notes: Jennica is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jennica is derived from the Latin name Iovanna, which means 'Jehovah is gracious'. It is also derived from the Greek name Helenike, meaning 'shining light'. This name carries the symbolism of a precious jewel, one who is gracious and radiant. The name Jennica carries the meaning “Jewel, gracious one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jennica usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, gracious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jennica total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
